_comment: MCP server registration examples for Notion TDD Agent (notion-tdd-agent on npm).

claude_code_recommended._comment: Recommended: install from npm via npx. Add to ~/.claude/settings.json or your project's .claude/settings.json.

local_development_no_build._comment: Local development — cloned repo, no build step required. Requires tsx in devDependencies.

local_development_built._comment: Local development — cloned repo, after running: npm run build. Env from .env file.

setup_steps: 1. Get your Notion token: https://app.notion.com/developers/connections → New connection → Access token
2. Create (or pick) a Notion page to hold your TDDs; share it with the integration via Page → Connections
3. Copy the 32-char page ID from the page URL
4. Copy the claude_code_recommended block above into ~/.claude/settings.json (global) or .claude/settings.json (project)
5. Replace the placeholder env values with your real token and page ID
6. Restart Claude Code or Claude Desktop
